name: Mamba
sourceText:
Mamba Switches pay tribute to a legend. They're constructed with the extremely smooth molds the community is familiar with from JWK. They feature an extended long pole stem made of LY for exceptionally satisfying bottom-out feel and acoustics. This is coupled with an improved factory lubing technique, making them arguably great without modding.
What is LY?
LY is an UHMWPE blend made by JWK aimed to combine UHMWPE's natural lower coefficient of friction, self-lubricating properties, and resistance to abrasion with enhanced structural integrity. UHMWPE on its own is an extremely soft material prone to deforming in instances of high stress such as when stems are friction fitted into keycaps. This can result in wobble, or in extreme cases keycaps simply falling off. This blend ensures those issues do not occur. Additionally, the increased rigidity will produce a louder, fuller sound on bottom-out than a comparable pure UHMWPE stem.

Maximum Light Transmittance
UC Nylon was developed with RGB fans in mind and aims to offer maximum light diffusion through fully transperant housings. Additionally, new molds were developed for the material with polished cavities to minimize visible abberrations.
Improved Smoothness
UC Nylon is a curated blend designed to reduce the course nature of pure nylon without impacting other favorable properties of nylon such as sound. Coupled with new polished molds, these switches aim to be a step above full nylon compositions.

specs.mount: The Hajimari65 uses a superior 6 point gasket-mount structure to

sourceText:
Introducing Hajimari65, a keyboard designed and manufactured in Las Vegas by Geeks Don't Panic to accompany an epic story of honor, betrayal, and strife. Originally released alongside The Crox: Chapter 1, each board features design inspiration from this developing story.
What Makes the Hajimari65 Special?
Story Meets Design:
The Hajimari65 was crafted with the intent to tell a story. The board features a tucked top row inspired by the village hidden from the world, protected by a vast mountain range. Continuing with this theme, the board provides an unassuming minimal exterior, but flaunts beautiful artwork on both the plate and PCB.
Gasket-mount:
The Hajimari65 uses a superior 6 point gasket-mount structure to isolate the plate and PCB from the case. By evenly diffusing the pressure of each keystroke the Hajimari65 is able to provide a comfortable, and bouncy typing experience to minimize fatigue during extended typing sessions.
Hot-swappable:
The Hajimari65 features Kailh hot-swap sockets. This means you'll be able to easily swap your switches without any soldering! In just a few minutes, you can change the sound and feel of your board completely!
Enhanced Acoustics:
Numerous iterations of the PCB were made to fine-tune the acoustics of the Hajimari65. Ultimately, flex-cuts were avoided to ensure a full, and crisp sound signature.
Screwless Exterior:
Taking advantage of the 3 piece case, the Hajimari65 is able to hide all mounting screws resulting in an extremely minimal exterior.
Collectible Weights:
The Hajimari65 was designed with customizability in mind. Numerous weights (also known as Croxes) are planned to release in various colors, and designs as the story progresses allowing you to fully personalize your board.
Meticulously Manufactured in Las Vegas, NV
Each portion of the Hajimari65 case is carefully inspected, machined, and sandblasted by hand at the Geeks Dont Panic warehouse in Las Vegas, NV using locally sourced aluminum 6061.

name: Melon Milk - Linear
sourceText:
Melon Milk Linears were designed to provide a mellow typing experience inspired by the delicate flavors of the dessert they're themed after. They feature near full travel and HPE housings for a softer bottom out. The HPE housings also provide for a smoother typing experience. Additionally, we’ve opted for custom single staged gold plated long springs in a lighter weight to reduce spring noise and improve comfort during extended typing sessions.
We hope you enjoy this treat! As part of our Fruit Milk Series of switches they will also include a matching collectible milk bottle, and sticker for qualified orders!
What Makes Our Melon Milk Switches Special?
HPE Housing
HPE is an updated UHMWPE blend designed to reduce the malleability of pure UHMWPE. This ensures the switches can withstand the wears of normal use while retaining other benefits of UHMWPE such as a lower coefficient of friction (when compared to POM), self lubrication, and resistance to abrasion.
Custom Single Stage Gold Plated Long Spring
Melon Milk Switches feature custom made 22mm single stage gold plated long springs to further reduce spring noise. The extended length means the springs will sit at a more compressed state translating to a higher initial weight, however, they will bottom out at a light 63.5g. This narrow window of operation between the initial weight and bottom out force results in a snappier typing experience while the light bottom out weight minimizes fatigue during extended typing sessions.
Near Full Travel
By extending the travel distance in our Melon Milk Switches to 3.9mm we reduce the likelihood of downstrokes creating similar levels of impact experienced in extremely long-pole switches. This provides both a physically softer bottom out, and quieter lower-pitched acoustics.

name: Lychee Milk Linear Switches
sourceText:
Lychee Milk Linears feature an UHMWPE stem and full nylon housing. UHMWPE is a unique material with a lower coefficient of friction than POM. It’s a softer material that’s self-lubricating, and highly resistant to abrasion. Together these properties provide a smooth typing experience with a soft bottom and top-out sound. They’re also meant to be a V2 to our original Lychee Switches!
We hope you enjoy this treat! As part of our Fruit Milk Series of switches they will also include a free matching collectible milk bottle, and sticker for qualified orders!
What Improvements Have Been Made?
Updated Stem Molds
New stem molds have been created to account for UHMWPE’s malleable nature. The revised stems aim to reduce stem wobble and improve keycap fitment compared to the original Lychees.
Updated Springs
Gold plated long 23mm springs are now included in the switches to improve both sound and feel. These long springs provide a slightly higher initial force, steady force increase, and snappy return.
What Makes Our Lychee Milk Switches Special?
Nylon Housing
Lychee Milk Switches feature nylon housings. Nylon is a common switch material often preferred for its acoustic properties. Generally, nylon switches provide a fuller deeper sound when the stem collides during a keystroke.
Custom Gold Plated Long Spring
Lychee Milk Switches feature custom made 23mm gold plated long springs to further reduce spring noise. The extended length means the springs will sit at a more compressed state translating to a higher initial weight, however, they will bottom out at a moderate 68g. This narrow window of operation between the initial weight and bottom out force results in a snappy typing experience.
UHMWPE Stem
The 13.0mm stem length of the Lychee Milk Switches allow for the side rails to collide with the bottom housing rather than the central pole. Coupled with the softness of UHMWPE this provides for a unique bottom-out sound and feel.

The Zoom65 V3 keyboard brings the advantages of HE in a beautiful, highly customizable case. Game at your best without any aesthetic sacrifice to your set-up.
Magnetic PCB Connectors:
The Zoom65 V3 keyboard's magnetic PCB connectors satisfyingly click into place and eliminate messy cables during assembly.
4 Modular Blockers:
The Zoom65 V3 keyboard features multiple blockers - 1u key, badge, knob, or screen!
Screw-less Case:
The Zoom65 V3 keyboard utilizes a truly screw-less closure by incorporating a unique ball-catch mechanism to disengage the top and bottom case for easy customization!
New Stabilizers:
Each kit will include Wuque Studio's new "Stupid Stabilizers". These stabilizers use a clip-in design to eliminate screws, include silicone around the wire to reduce rattle, and utilize a TPU silicone stem to reduce friction with the wires.
Zoom65 V3 EE At a Glance:
Various Plate Materials:
TheZoom65 V3 EE is highly customizable featuring numerous plate options including brass, aluminum, polycarbonate, POM, carbon fiber and FR4. Fully customize your typing experience with theZoom65 V3 EE. Please note, additional plates are sold separately.
Hot-swappable:
TheZoom65 V3 EE PCB features Kailh Hot Swap sockets which allows you to easily swap your switches, no soldering required! Changing switches is a breeze, you can go from linears to tactiles in a matter of minutes, all on the same keyboard!
Bluetooth PCB:
Leave the wires behind and use yourZoom65 V3 with your PC / Mac / tablet / phone with ease. The PCB has a polling rate of 1000hz in wired mode. The included battery can go many weeks between charges. Customize any key in the VIA app for Windows, Mac or Linux.
Included Foam:
TheZoom65 V3 EE Kit comes with an array of foams in the kit for those who like a dampened, refined sound. Feel free to experiment with different combinations, or use none of them at all!
Included Extras:
TheZoom65 V3 EE comes with almost everything you need to put together your first keyboard, including an USB-C cable, premium WS stabilizers, and carrying case. All you need are switches and keycaps of your choice to build the ultimate keyboard that's uniquely yours.
